headline: Bridgeport and Georgian Court alone still unbeaten
dek: Georgian Court have won once and drawn twice, scoring seven and conceding four, and their first win came at home to Staten Island after draws on the road at Bentley and Saint Michael's. Bridgeport's record is the same shape, a win and two draws. Every other programme in the CACC has already been beaten.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Georgian Court's seven goals have come from six different scorers, and so have Bridgeport's. The two tallest bars on the chart are both spreads of contributions rather than any individual's tally.

wire.line: Bridgeport and Georgian Court remain unbeaten; every other side in the conference has already lost.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches carry a published result but no box score, and all three are Goldey-Beacom's: the defeat by Pace, the goalless draw with District of Columbia, and the defeat at Bloomsburg. The site has those scores and not the shape of them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Post's home match with Bentley has passed its date without a published result, the only match in the conference in that state.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jefferson have lost all three of their matches, conceding twelve goals against three scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Max Bond has now made 28 saves for Chestnut Hill and conceded seven, a save percentage of .800.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Bartu Yakkan has scored three of Felician's six goals and assisted two of the others.

last_match.line: Jefferson have lost every match they have played and have conceded more than any other CACC programme.

next_match.line: Georgian Court are unbeaten but have yet to win away from home; Pitt-Johnstown have already won at Chestnut Hill this week.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
